doc:
A class to create and display a version of your network.

This can be used to assist in the debugging and visualisation of your network and will not be assessed.

It is highly recommended you use this sparingly for visualisation purposes and use JUnit tests for the majority of your testing. @given

methods.name: instantiateClasses
display
methods.doc:
Displays the items in testNetwork using their toString methods.

The display is in the format:

  • intersection: [INTERSECTION_NAME]
  • [Route1 toString()]
  • ...
  • [Routen toString()]
for each intersection @param testNetwork a list of intersections that are to be displayed @given
